verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of Atlas renewal charges, such as recurring registered-agent fees, or of cancellation or transfer-out terms for moving the entity away from Atlas. The docs only say a registered agent is provided. Community mentions of setup price and ongoing running costs are anecdotal and do not document renewal or exit terms.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, renewal charges and cancellation or transfer-out terms are documented, so leaving the service does not strand the entity
